description: This file defines a generic asynchronous observer class used within the Orleans streaming framework to facilitate observation via delegates, implementing the IAsyncObserver interface.

classes.name: GenericAsyncObserver<T>
classes.description: A generic class implementing IAsyncObserver<T> to handle asynchronous stream notifications via delegate functions.

methods.name: GenericAsyncObserver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes delegate functions for handling OnNext, OnError, and OnCompleted events.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Invokes the onNextAsync delegate with the provided item and token.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Invokes the onCompletedAsync delegate to signal stream completion.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Invokes the onErrorAsync delegate with the provided exception.
